name.zh: 东莞市展益五金制品有限公司
name.en: Dongguan Zhanyi Hardware Products Co., Ltd.

responseTarget.zh: 我们的服务目标是：收到完整项目资料后24小时内完成首次评审，并把下一步说明清楚。
responseTarget.en: Our service target is to review complete project information within 24 hours and make the next step clear.

disclaimer.zh: 能力场景图为示意视觉，产品图片用于展示可沟通的代表性零件类型。最终材料、工艺、表面处理与尺寸，以确认图纸和项目约定为准。
disclaimer.en: Capability visuals are illustrative, and product photography represents part families open for discussion. Final materials, processes, finishes and dimensions are defined by the approved drawing and project agreement.

description.zh: 展益以严谨评审、务实制造和清晰负责的项目沟通，帮助工程与采购团队让复杂金属设计稳妥走向生产。
description.en: Zhanyi helps engineering and sourcing teams move demanding metal designs into production through disciplined review, practical manufacturing and clear project ownership.

imageAlt.zh: 示意：现代精密五金冲压生产场景
imageAlt.en: Illustrative modern precision metal stamping scene

title.zh: 为精准装配而制造，为稳定量产而准备
title.en: Built to Fit. Prepared to Repeat.

description.zh: 从精密冲压件到完整机箱，每一个工艺决定都回到零件如何配合、如何工作，以及如何被清晰验收。
description.en: From precision stampings to complete enclosures, every process decision begins with how the part must fit, function and be inspected.

imageAlt.zh: 示意：精密模具检测与制造场景

title.zh: 关键金属部件，更需要清晰而可靠的制造
title.en: Critical Metal Components, Handled with Clarity.

description.zh: 铜排、端子、盖板、托盘、支架与箱体，从材料和结构评审开始，把连接、装配、检验与交付边界逐项说清。
description.en: For busbars, terminals, covers, trays, brackets and enclosures, we align material, geometry, assembly, inspection and delivery before production begins.

imageAlt.zh: 示意：国际项目团队评审钣金组件

title.zh: 从最终装配出发，做对每一步制造决策
title.en: Manufacturing Decisions Made with the Final Assembly in Mind

intro.zh: 我们从图纸与应用场景出发，在生产开始前，把材料特性、成形策略、模具、表面处理与检验方式逐项对齐。
intro.en: We begin with your drawing and application, then align material behavior, forming strategy, tooling, finish and inspection before production begins.

description.zh: 把折弯、接触特征、安装孔位与装配关系作为一个整体评审，让冲压件更贴近图纸定义的配合与功能。
description.en: Complex bends, contact features and mounting geometry are considered as one system, so stamped parts stay aligned with the fit and function defined in your drawing.

description.zh: 面向重复量产的端子与成形件，在料带布局和工序顺序中同时考虑一致性、材料利用与后续自动化装配。
description.en: For repeat-volume terminals and formed components, strip layout and operation sequence are developed with consistency, material use and downstream assembly in view.

description.zh: 机箱、面板与外壳不只是切割和折弯成形，更要同时照顾接口、通风、外观、装配和维护空间。
description.en: Chassis, panels and enclosures are planned around interfaces, airflow, appearance, assembly and service access, not simply cut and bent to shape.

description.zh: 把内部布局转化为可执行的面板拆分、安装特征、通风与检修结构，并衔接五金件和子组件装配。
description.en: We translate internal layouts into practical panel breaks, mounting features, ventilation and access, then coordinate hardware and subassembly needs.

description.zh: 压接区、弹性特征与插接几何需要一起判断，才能让端子与触点更好地适配预定的电气装配关系。
description.en: Crimp zones, spring features and mating geometry are reviewed together to support the intended fit within the electrical assembly.

description.zh: 面向电池与储能设备的铜排、盖板、托盘和支架，围绕走向、绝缘界面、通风与结构承托规划制造。
description.en: Busbars, covers, trays and brackets are planned around routing, insulation interfaces, ventilation and structural support within battery and energy-storage equipment.

description.zh: 在模具或生产启动前，尽早识别结构、材料和装配风险，让问题在仍有调整空间时得到解决。
description.en: Before tooling or production begins, we surface geometry, material and assembly risks while there is still time to resolve them efficiently.

description.zh: 把表面处理视为功能与装配的一部分，结合使用环境、遮蔽区域和外观标准衔接喷粉、镀层、氧化与拉丝。
description.en: Finish is treated as part of function and assembly, with coating, plating, anodizing and brushing aligned to service conditions, masking and appearance expectations.

title.zh: 零件不只是成形，更要胜任它在设备中的职责
title.en: Metal Components Designed Around the Work They Must Do

intro.zh: 连接、承托、防护、散热与维护方式，都会改变一件金属零件应当如何设计制造。我们从实际用途出发，而不是从工艺清单出发。
intro.en: Connection, support, protection, thermal management and service access all shape the right manufacturing route. We begin with the application, not a process list.

description.zh: 电池与储能设备中的连接几何、绝缘界面、通风和结构承托需要协同考虑。我们面向这些装配关系制造铜排、盖板、托盘、支架与箱体。
description.en: In battery and energy-storage equipment, connection geometry, insulation interfaces, ventilation and structural support must work together. We manufacture busbars, covers, trays, brackets and enclosures around those relationships.

description.zh: 从接线盒和电源机壳，到端子、触点和结构盖板，零件需要兼顾连接、模块安装、维护空间与防护要求。
description.en: From junction boxes and power chassis to terminals, contacts and covers, each part must balance connection, module mounting, service access and protection.

description.zh: 工业设备中的底盘、面板、护罩和支架，既要适配内部布局，也要经得起装配、维护与重复使用中的实际要求。
description.en: Chassis, panels, guards and brackets for industrial equipment are developed around internal layouts, assembly access, maintenance and repeated use.

description.zh: 紧凑空间里的端子、弹片、支架与外壳，对孔位、折弯、接触和装配关系更敏感，需要在生产前把关键细节确认清楚。
description.en: Terminals, clips, brackets and housings in compact electronics depend on precise relationships between holes, bends, contacts and assembly features.

description.zh: 机架式机箱、通风底盘、接口面板与内部支架围绕模块化布局、散热路径和维护便利性展开。
description.en: Rackmount chassis, ventilated bases, interface panels and internal brackets are planned around modular layouts, airflow and serviceability.

description.zh: 不锈钢柜体、操作面板、门盖与结构组件，在满足日常使用的同时，也要兼顾外观、清洁和易维护性。
description.en: Stainless cabinets, operator panels, doors and structural assemblies balance daily use with appearance, cleaning and maintainability.

summary.zh: 它始于正确的图纸版本、对关键特征的共同理解，以及清晰的验收依据。从材料识别到最终放行，每一道检查都回到项目真正需要什么。
summary.en: It begins with the correct drawing revision, a shared understanding of critical features and clear acceptance criteria. From material identification to final release, every check ties back to what the project actually requires.

description.zh: 以双方确认的图纸版本作为生产、检验与变更沟通的共同依据，减少信息不一致带来的风险。
description.en: One confirmed revision becomes the common reference for production, inspection and change communication, reducing avoidable ambiguity.

description.zh: 在生产放行前确认材料牌号、状态与表面需求，并按项目需要规划标识和相关资料。
description.en: Material grade, condition and finish are confirmed before production release, with identification and supporting records planned where the project requires them.

description.zh: 批量生产前，依据确认图纸复核关键尺寸、孔位、折弯、装配关系与外观，让问题停在量产之前。
description.en: Before volume production, the first article is reviewed against the approved drawing for critical dimensions, holes, bends, assembly relationships and appearance.

description.zh: 把检验节点放在工艺变化真正会影响结果的位置，及时关注冲压、折弯、连接与表面处理状态。
description.en: Checkpoints are placed where process variation matters, with attention to stamping, bending, joining and finishing as the work progresses.

description.zh: 包装前再次确认数量、外观、关键特征、装配状态及项目约定资料，确保交付有明确依据。
description.en: Before packing, quantity, appearance, key features, assembly status and agreed documentation are reviewed against the project basis.

description.zh: 根据项目实际需要规划图纸版本、首件确认、检验记录与包装标识，让双方对“什么是合格”保持一致理解。
description.en: Drawing revisions, first-article approvals, inspection records and packing identification are planned to the project, keeping both sides aligned on what acceptance means.

title.zh: 从首次评审到最终交付，每一步都更清楚
title.en: A Clearer Path from First Review to Final Delivery

intro.zh: 您应该始终知道哪些事项已经确认、哪些问题仍待决定，以及项目下一步会发生什么。
intro.en: You should always know what has been confirmed, what remains open and what happens next.

description.zh: 图纸、样件、用途、数量或目标时间都可以成为起点，资料越完整，首次判断越有效。
description.en: Drawings, samples, application, quantity and target timing all help us begin; the clearer the input, the more useful the first review.

description.zh: 评审可能影响成形、装配、外观、检验与成本的关键问题，并把需要确认的事项尽早提出。
description.en: We identify questions that may affect forming, assembly, appearance, inspection or cost while there is still time to act.

title.zh: 让方案与报价基于同一前提
title.en: Align the Route and Commercial Scope

description.zh: 建议工艺、报价边界、开放问题与项目节奏基于同一套资料确认，减少后续理解偏差。
description.en: The proposed process, quotation scope, open points and project timing are aligned against one shared set of information.

title.en: Use the Sample to Confirm the Real Result

description.zh: 依据确认版本检查关键结构、装配与外观，并把调整内容记录清楚，再进入下一阶段。
description.en: The sample is reviewed for critical geometry, fit and appearance, with adjustments recorded before the project moves forward.

description.zh: 让已确认的图纸、样件与检验节点贯穿生产过程，使制造执行与验收依据保持一致。
description.en: Approved drawings, samples and inspection points guide production so execution and acceptance remain aligned.

title.zh: 把交付细节也纳入项目
title.en: Treat Delivery Details as Part of the Project

description.zh: 完成终检后确认包装、标签、数量与交付安排，让零件以约定状态抵达下一环节。
description.en: After final review, packing, labeling, quantity and delivery details are confirmed so parts arrive in the agreed condition.

title.zh: 把复杂的制造工作，沟通得清楚，执行得扎实
title.en: A Manufacturing Partner That Keeps the Work Clear

overview.zh: 东莞市展益五金制品有限公司专注定制金属零部件，覆盖精密冲压件、钣金机箱、端子触点、插头五金、电源结构件、新能源五金以及支架与散热件。不同产品背后，我们坚持同一套工作逻辑：先理解零件要完成什么，再明确生产需要控制什么，并让从评审到交付的关键决定始终清晰可见。
overview.en: Dongguan Zhanyi Hardware Products Co., Ltd. manufactures custom metal components across precision stampings, sheet metal enclosures, terminals and contacts, plug hardware, power structures, new-energy hardware, brackets and heat sinks. Across that range, one working principle remains constant: understand what the part must do, define what production must control and keep key decisions visible from review through delivery.

positioning.zh: 我们相信，可靠的供应商不只负责把零件做出来，也应该尽早提出问题、坦诚说明取舍，并让客户随时清楚项目进行到哪里。
positioning.en: We believe a dependable supplier should do more than make parts. It should raise questions early, explain trade-offs honestly and make it easy for customers to understand where a project stands.

title.zh: 不同零件，同一份责任标准

description.zh: 无论是小型端子还是完整机箱，项目都从功能、配合与验收边界开始。
description.en: Whether the part is a compact terminal or a complete enclosure, the project begins with function, fit and acceptance.

description.zh: 围绕版本、材料、关键特征、装配关系和外观要求展开每一次工艺与质量沟通。
description.en: Revision, material, critical features, assembly relationships and appearance anchor every process and quality discussion.

title.zh: 让问题停在成为延误之前
title.en: Questions Raised Before They Become Delays

description.zh: 在生产前提出成形、孔位、折弯、连接与表面问题，为调整保留时间和选择。
description.en: Forming, hole, bend, joining and finish questions are raised before production, while there is still room to choose.

title.zh: 跨越语言，保持信息清晰

description.zh: 双语内容、结构化询盘和清晰资料清单，让跨境项目从第一次沟通起就更容易推进。
description.en: Bilingual content, structured RFQs and clear information checklists make cross-border projects easier to move from the first conversation.

title.zh: 一张图纸，就可以开始一次专业对话
title.en: A Drawing Is Enough to Start a Better Manufacturing Conversation

description.zh: 发送零件资料、用途与数量需求。我们的服务目标是在收到完整信息后24小时内完成首次评审，并明确下一步。
description.en: Share the part information, application and expected quantity. Our service target is to complete an initial review within 24 hours of receiving complete information and clarify the next step.

title.zh: 让五金项目少走弯路的工程思考
title.en: Practical Thinking for Better Metal Parts

intro.zh: 写给希望把图纸、询价与量产交接做得更清楚的工程师和采购团队。
intro.en: Notes for engineers and sourcing teams who want clearer drawings, better RFQs and smoother production handoffs.

title.zh: 冲压还是激光切割：为当前项目选择合适的起点
title.en: Stamping or Laser Cutting? Choose for the Project You Have Today

excerpt.zh: 合适的起始工艺取决于结构、数量、变更风险与模具经济性，而不是单独比较一个零件价格。
excerpt.en: The right starting process depends on geometry, volume, change risk and tooling economics, not one unit price.

heading.zh: 先看结构，也看项目阶段
heading.en: Start with Geometry and Project Stage

body.zh: 激光切割通常更适合需要快速验证或仍可能调整的项目；当结构趋于稳定、数量提升且重复性更重要时，冲压与模具方案可能更有价值。选择时应把折弯顺序、公差策略和后续变更一起考虑。
body.en: Laser cutting often suits early validation or designs that may still change. As geometry stabilizes, volume rises and repeatability matters more, stamping and dedicated tooling may become the stronger route. Bend sequence, tolerance strategy and future changes should be considered together.

heading.zh: 比较项目总成本，而不只是单件价格

body.zh: 单件价格无法完整反映模具、换线、二次工序、检验、材料利用与预期生命周期。把这些因素放进同一张比较表，才能看清哪种工艺真正适合项目。
body.en: Piece price alone hides tooling, setup, secondary operations, inspection, material use and expected program life. Put them on one comparison sheet to see which route truly fits the project.

heading.zh: 用同一套资料做出可比较的判断

body.zh: 提供二维图、三维模型、材料、数量区间、关键尺寸、表面要求与目标时间，并标出哪些位置允许讨论。只有输入一致，工艺与报价才真正可比。
body.en: Provide 2D drawings, 3D models, material, volume ranges, critical dimensions, finish and target timing, and mark what is open to discussion. Comparable input leads to comparable process and quotation decisions.

title.zh: 钣金机箱询价前：一次能减少返工的结构检查
title.en: Before You Quote a Sheet Metal Enclosure: A Design Review That Reduces Rework

excerpt.zh: 先把装配基准、功能面、外观面与五金件关系说清楚，往往比后期反复修改更有效。
excerpt.en: Clear assembly datums, functional surfaces, cosmetic expectations and hardware relationships before quotation to reduce later rework.

heading.zh: 先定义装配从哪里开始

body.zh: 明确底板、接口、导轨或内部模块所依赖的基准，并标出关键孔位与配合尺寸。没有共同基准，零件即使单独合格，也可能在总装时出现偏差。
body.en: Identify the datums used by the base, interfaces, rails or internal modules, then mark critical holes and fit dimensions. Without a shared datum structure, individually acceptable parts can still miss alignment in final assembly.

heading.zh: 区分功能要求与外观要求

body.zh: 承载、接地、散热和接口区域应与主要外观面分开标识，并说明允许的焊点、挂点、色差与纹理范围，避免验收标准停留在主观判断。
body.en: Separate load-bearing, grounding, thermal and interface zones from primary cosmetic surfaces. Define acceptable weld visibility, rack marks, color variation and texture so appearance is not left to subjective judgment.

heading.zh: 把五金件和装配方向纳入图纸

body.zh: 压铆件、螺柱、铰链、把手和密封件会影响孔位、折弯顺序与可达空间。应在询价资料中明确型号、方向和装配责任。
body.en: Inserted hardware, studs, hinges, handles and seals affect holes, bend sequence and tool access. Include part references, orientation and assembly responsibility in the RFQ package.

title.zh: 选择金属表面处理：先满足功能，再定义外观
title.en: Choosing a Metal Finish: Start with Function, Then Define Appearance

excerpt.zh: 耐腐蚀、导电、绝缘、装配与外观并非独立问题，合适的表面方案需要把它们放在一起判断。
excerpt.en: Corrosion resistance, conductivity, insulation, assembly and appearance are connected decisions, not separate checkboxes.

heading.zh: 先理解零件将在哪里工作

body.zh: 室内、户外、潮湿、高温、清洁频率与化学接触都会影响表面处理选择。先说明环境和预期寿命，再讨论颜色与质感。
body.en: Indoor or outdoor use, humidity, heat, cleaning frequency and chemical exposure all influence finish selection. Define the environment and expected life before discussing color and texture.

heading.zh: 把不能覆盖的位置明确标出来
heading.en: Mark Areas That Must Remain Uncoated

body.zh: 接地点、配合面、螺纹、导电接触区和精密尺寸可能需要遮蔽或特殊处理。若这些区域没有提前定义，表面处理会直接影响装配与功能。
body.en: Grounding points, mating surfaces, threads, conductive contact zones and precision dimensions may require masking or special treatment. If they are not defined early, the finish can directly affect fit and function.

heading.zh: 用可执行的方式定义外观

body.zh: 尽量通过色号、光泽、纹理样板、主外观面和可接受差异说明要求，让供应商知道应当如何检验，而不是只写“外观良好”。
body.en: Use color references, gloss, texture samples, primary cosmetic surfaces and acceptable variation so the supplier knows how appearance will be judged, rather than relying on “good appearance.”

title.zh: 一份更好的五金件询价：让供应商给出更好的答案
title.en: A Better Metal Parts RFQ: Information That Leads to Better Answers

excerpt.zh: 完整而有重点的资料不仅缩短问答往返，也能让工艺建议、报价边界和交期判断更可靠。
excerpt.en: A complete, focused RFQ reduces question cycles and produces more useful process, quotation and delivery decisions.

heading.zh: 先给出决定制造方案的技术信息
heading.en: Provide the Technical Information That Drives the Route

body.zh: 二维图、三维模型、材料、厚度、关键特征、装配用途、表面要求和版本信息，共同决定零件应当如何制造与检验。
body.en: 2D drawings, 3D models, material, thickness, critical features, assembly use, finish and revision information together determine how the part should be made and inspected.

heading.zh: 数量和时间同样是工程输入
heading.en: Quantity and Timing Are Engineering Inputs Too

body.zh: 样件数量、预计批量、年用量、目标时间、包装和交付地区都会影响模具、工艺、产能安排与报价方式。
body.en: Prototype quantity, expected batch size, annual volume, target timing, packing and delivery region influence tooling, process, capacity planning and quotation structure.

heading.zh: 明确哪些内容可以讨论
heading.en: Show What Is Open to Discussion

body.zh: 若材料、表面、局部结构或公差存在调整空间，请直接标注。清楚的开放项能让制造方提出替代方案，而不会误改真正关键的设计意图。
body.en: If material, finish, local geometry or tolerances have room for adjustment, say so. Clear open points invite practical alternatives without compromising the design intent that matters.

title.zh: 把图纸发来，让下一步更清楚
title.en: Send the Drawing. Let Us Make the Next Step Clear.

description.zh: 告诉我们零件要完成什么、预计数量、材料或表面要求，以及希望何时交付。收到完整资料后，我们的服务目标是在24小时内完成首次评审，并回复下一步所需信息。
description.en: Tell us what the part must do, the quantity you expect, any material or finish requirements and your target timing. Once the information is complete, our service target is to review it within 24 hours and respond with the next questions or recommended step.

successMessage.zh: 感谢提交，您的询盘已经送达。我们会认真查看资料，并带着需要确认的问题或建议的下一步与您联系。
successMessage.en: Thank you. Your inquiry is with us. We will review the information and contact you with any questions or the recommended next step.
